newsitem.title: USA: Body found at Miami Beach siege site - TV.
newsitem.headline: Body found at Miami Beach siege site - TV.

text.p: A body was found inside the houseboat besieged earlier on Wednesday by Miami police hunting Andrew Cunanan, suspected to have killed Italian fashion czar Gianni Versace, local television said.

Local Channel Six television said the individual appeared to have committed suicide. No comment was immediately available from police, who have not confirmed Cunanan was at the site and earlier said no one was found inside the houseboat.
Local radio WINZ said the body of a man had been found inside but gave no details.
Miami Beach police were scheduled to give a news conference later on Wednesday.
Heavily armed police besieged and then stormed the houseboat after receiving a report that a man possibly resembling Cunanan had fired a gun at the dwelling's caretaker.
Cunanan is the subject of a nationwide manhunt. He is suspected by the FBI of killing four men as well as of shooting Versace to death July 15 in Miami Beach.
